name: A Talent for Not Being Seen
game_text:
<keyword>Stealth</keyword>. To play, exert a Hobbit.
Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Shadow number −1 (or spot 4 to make it −2).
flavor_text: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.
